1	Change: Kimi source-control generation now requests official JavaScript Kimi stream-json output. The Kimi decoder preserves multiline assistant content, ignores role metadata and tool results, and selects the latest assistant message without tool_calls only after a successful process exit. Hook text and tool narration must not enter the generated commit, branch, or pull request text.

{"base":"main","title":"Decode Kimi generation output using the effective command format","body":"## Problem
Generated commit, branch, and pull request text could lose line breaks or include tool output and metadata because shared cleanup guessed the output format.

## Solution
Choose the Kimi stream-json decoder from the effective command format so generated text contains only the intended assistant response.

- Request official JavaScript Kimi stream-json output for source-control generation.
- Preserve multiline content and select the latest assistant message without tool calls only after the process exits successfully.
- Ignore tool results, role metadata, and other non-answer records.","draft":false}
